_source_row.description: One-based ordinal in the pinned processed Parquet; added without dropping source rows.
_source_row.join_hint: Unique only within this table and source commit; not an applicant or application identifier across releases.

unique_identifier.description: Agency-redacted/pseudonymous applicant identifier provided in the source; it may repeat across applications.
unique_identifier.join_hint: Not a unique application key. Cross-form, cross-release and EOIR/ICE linkage is not established by this importer.

ben_year_of_birth.description: Applicant year of birth reported by the source; integer, with source missingness retained.

ben_country_of_birth.description: Applicant birthplace, not residence. The publisher maps C3 codes to names: failed lookups become NULL in DACA but Unlisted Entry (Any foreign country not listed) in TPS. That TPS category can conflate unresolved/invalid/missing original codes; stored NULL counts do not measure all underlying missingness. ELIS names are retained after publisher UTF-8 repair.

immigration_status.description: Original source immigration-status field. Values are retained without inferring current lawful status.

classification.description: Original source classification field; interpret with the USCIS source documentation rather than a newly invented category mapping.

form_number.description: Application form designation: the tables separately cover DACA I-821D and TPS I-821.

form_type.description: Source-reported initial/renewal/re-registration form type where available. Legacy-system missingness remains.

latest_trvl_depart_yr.description: Year of the latest travel departure reported in the source; not a complete travel history.

latest_trvl_return_yr.description: Year of the latest travel return reported in the source; not a complete travel history.

status.description: Application/case status recorded in the source snapshot; not necessarily final disposition or current beneficiary status.

status_date.description: Source date associated with the recorded status; preserved as DATE.

uscis_field_office.description: Processing field-office label. It does not identify applicant residence.
uscis_field_office.join_hint: Do not substitute ICE offices/AORs or infer residence geography from this USCIS processing office.

uscis_service_center.description: Processing service-center label; not applicant residence geography.

data_source.description: USCIS case-management source system, such as C3/CLAIMS3 or ELIS. Fields and missingness vary across systems.

lpr_date.description: Source lawful-permanent-residence date field, where reported; not a complete longitudinal status history.

ben_gender.description: Source gender field after publisher harmonization of legacy codes; labels and missingness are retained.

rec_date.description: Application receipt date reported by USCIS; source duplicate groups use applicant and this date.

decision_date.description: Application decision date in the source; any date-order anomalies are reported and retained.

decision.description: Source decision label; no independent recoding of approval/denial or beneficiary status.

latest_notice_type.description: Most recent source notice-type label; not a complete notice history.

latest_notice_date.description: Date associated with the most recent source notice.

latest_rfe_date.description: Most recent request-for-evidence date reported in the source.

latest_noid_date.description: Most recent notice-of-intent-to-deny date reported in the source.

g28_flag.description: Original source G-28 representation flag; retained as text, without inferring complete attorney coverage.

duplicate_identifier.description: Publisher's receipt-date group counter within an applicant grouping; not globally unique.
duplicate_identifier.join_hint: Interpret with applicant identifier/source scope; _source_row identifies a stored row.

duplicate_last.description: Last row within the publisher's applicant/receipt-date group. DACA sorts applicant (with a unique placeholder for each missing ID), receipt date, file_original, row_original; TPS additionally sorts decision_date before file_original/row_original. Later DACA reconstruction reorders rows, so physical _source_row does not reconstruct this flag.

duplicate_likely.description: Publisher's likely-duplicate flag for repeated applicant/receipt-date groups; NULL when applicant ID or receipt date is missing.

duplicate_drop_row.description: Publisher recommendation: coalesce(duplicate_likely,FALSE) AND NOT duplicate_last. Every row is retained. On unknown duplicate_likely rows this flag is false because of coalescing, not verified absence of duplication.

file_original.description: Original agency input-file identifier retained by the publisher.
file_original.join_hint: Pair with row_original and table/source commit. This pair is nonmissing and unique in both full pinned tables; no stability across releases is established.

row_original.description: Row number in the original agency input file, distinct from _source_row in the processed Parquet.
row_original.join_hint: Pair with file_original and table/source commit; the pair is nonmissing and unique in this snapshot, not a persistent application or person ID.

form_type_filled_in.description: DACA: copies form_type for ELIS rows and every row with a missing applicant ID. Only C3 rows with a nonmissing ID are reconstructed: within applicant, ordered by decision_date, cumulative approvals including the current row give DACA - Initial when at most one, otherwise DACA - Renewal; an unknown cumulative count gives NULL. Duplicate approvals count, and a denied/pending renewal after the first approval can still be labelled Initial. This is not a uniformly observed or uniformly imputed field.
